_README: THE SHARED-ROOT CUTOVER LEVER. The office L: drive is RETIRED.
Do not put an L: path here. Shared data lives in the enneadtab.com depot.
1. EA_SHARED_ROOT environment variable ('OFFLINE' or any L: path = local dump)
3. THIS FILE (ships inside EA_Dist with every publish)
4. no share configured -> local dump, deliberately offline
An L: value in env or json is ignored. Never last-resort to L:.
'offline': true is the fleet default until a replacement UNC exists.
If a new share is stood up, set shared_root to that UNC and offline to false.
